import zipfile, collections
path='/workspace/tmp_inspect/scogs_animals.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    counts=collections.Counter()
    maxseq=0; maxname=None; maxlen=0; maxlen_name=None
    lens=collections.Counter()
    for n in z.namelist():
        if not n.endswith('.mafft'): continue
        data=z.read(n).decode('ascii')
        seqs=data.count('>')
        counts[seqs]+=1
        if seqs>maxseq: maxseq=seqs; maxname=n
        # alignment length as chars in first seq after header
        lines=data.splitlines()
        seqlines=[l for l in lines if l and not l.startswith('>')]
        if seqlines:
            alen=len(seqlines[0])
            if alen>maxlen: maxlen=alen; maxlen_name=n
    print('seq count distribution', counts)
    print('maxseq', maxseq, maxname, 'max alen', maxlen, maxlen_name)
